154: /// Create directory at a given `path`.
155: ///
156: /// ## Options
157: ///
158: /// * `recursive` --- create parent directories for the `path`, if they do not
159: ///     exist.
160: /// * `mode` --- file mode for the directories (not implemented on windows).
161: /// * `verbose` --- print a message for each printed directory.
162: ///
163: /// ## Trailing dot
164: ///
165: /// To match the GNU behavior, a path with the last directory being a single dot
166: /// (like `some/path/to/.`) is created (with the dot stripped).
167: pub fn mkdir(path: &Path, recursive: bool, mode: u32, verbose: bool) -> UResult<()> {
168:     // Special case to match GNU's behavior:
169:     // mkdir -p foo/. should work and just create foo/
170:     // std::fs::create_dir("foo/."); fails in pure Rust
171:     let path_buf = dir_strip_dot_for_creation(path);
172:     let context = MkdirContext {
173:         recursive,
174:         verbose,
175:     };
176:     let target = DirectorySpec::from_path(path_buf);
177:     #[cfg(not(windows))]
178:     let umask = mode::get_umask();
179:     #[cfg(windows)]
180:     let umask = 0;
181:     let perms = CreationMode::new(mode, umask, false);
182:     context.create_dir(&target, &perms)?;
183:     chmod(target.path(), perms.mode())
184: }

188:     use std::fs::{set_permissions, Permissions};
189:     use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
190: 
191:     let mode = Permissions::from_mode(mode);
192: 
193:     set_permissions(path, mode)
194:         .map_err_context(|| format!("cannot set permissions {}", path.quote()))
195: }

207:         if target.path().exists() && !self.recursive {
208:             return Err(DirectorySpec::error_exists(target.label()));
209:         }
210:         if target.path() == Path::new("") {
211:             return Ok(());
212:         }
213: 
214:         if self.recursive {
215:             match target.parent_path() {
216:                 Some(parent_path) => {
217:                     let parent = DirectorySpec::from_path(parent_path.to_path_buf());
218:                     self.create_dir(&parent, &perms.as_parent())?;
219:                 }
220:                 None => {
221:                     DirectorySpec::discard_missing_tree();
222:                 }
223:             }
224:         }
225:         match std::fs::create_dir(target.path()) {
226:             Ok(()) => {
227:                 if self.verbose {
228:                     println!(
229:                         "{}: created directory {}",
230:                         uucore::util_name(),
231:                         target.path().quote()
232:                     );
233:                 }
234:                 #[cfg(not(windows))]
235:                 if perms.is_parent() {
236:                     // directories created by -p have permission bits set to '=rwx,u+wx',

238:                     chmod(target.path(), (!perms.umask() & 0o0777) | 0o0300)?;
239:                 }
240:                 Ok(())
241:             }
242:             Err(_) if target.path().is_dir() => Ok(()),
243:             Err(e) => Err(e.into()),
244:         }
